verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an official documentation index. xAI also hosts a docs MCP server that gives agents direct access to its documentation, publishes docs pages as .md URLs, and serves a machine-readable openapi.json. Together these give agents several documented entry points into the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the docs MCP, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt contents are.
